blocks.raw: Engage+ includes a set of features that are not enabled by default. These are called gated features. To use a gated feature, contact your Customer Success Manager to get it enabled for your organization.
blocks.text: Engage+ includes a set of features that are not enabled by default. These are called gated features. To use a gated feature, contact your Customer Success Manager to get it enabled for your organization.

blocks.raw: The following table lists all the available gated features, along with links to learn more about each one.
blocks.text: The following table lists all the available gated features, along with links to learn more about each one.
